status: 已生成并核验的素材预览，尚未经用户确认，尚未接入网页。
style: 黑色手绘轮廓、白色内部填充、少量排线、透明背景；保留人物姿势、发饰与服饰细节。

assets.name: 挥手欢迎黑白线稿
prompts:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: clean black-and-white line drawing, transparent PNG web character.
Edit the attached WAVING woman illustration into a true black ink line-art version.
Preserve her exact waving pose, raised open hand and fingers, facial expression, face shape, hair silhouette, tall floral updo, dangling ornaments, clothing silhouette, robe folds, shoes, full-length framing and proportions. Do not invent a new pose or redesign the character.
Drawing style: hand-drawn black outlines on opaque white interior fills, fine black contour lines and just a few delicate black hatching strokes to describe hair and fabric folds. Make the result airy and readable, like a carefully inked sketchbook illustration. Hair should be outlined with sparse individual flowing strands and white open areas rather than dense black or gray fill. Preserve the flower and hairpin designs using delicate outlines.
Remove ALL color, watercolor washes, blush, gray washes and paper grain. Skin, robe, flower petals and most hair interior areas become clean opaque white. Keep dark eye details and clear black linework. This is contour line art, with minimal hatching.
Keep one complete full-body figure in the same portrait composition, with the entire top of her hairstyle, raised hand and complete robe hem visible. Transparent background with no scenery, glow, cast shadow, rectangle, text, border or watermark. All pixels outside the character silhouette must be actual alpha transparency; face and clothing inside the silhouette remain opaque white.

assets.name: 坐云休息黑白线稿
prompts:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: clean black-and-white line drawing, transparent PNG character and cloud for a hand-drawn website.
Edit the attached seated woman on a cloud into a true black ink LINE-ART illustration.
Preserve this exact character identity, face and calm smile, seated pose, hand positions, visible shoes, draped robe silhouette, tall flower-decorated updo, long hair, ornaments and the complete fluffy cloud silhouette. Preserve the horizontal composition and relative positions of all elements. Do not redesign the woman, change her pose or add new objects.
Use gently hand-drawn BLACK contour lines on clean opaque WHITE interior fills. Use only a few fine black hatching strokes to clarify hair directions and robe folds; keep the face and cloud especially clean and open. Hair should be white with expressive black strands rather than a dense black or gray filled mass. Make floral hair ornaments, bead chains and clothing embroidery readable with delicate black outlines.
Remove ALL color, watercolor washes, gray washes, blush and paper grain. Keep the linework consistent with an airy ink-on-paper sketchbook web illustration. No large shaded or gray-filled areas.
Show the entire woman and cloud, including her topmost hair ornaments and the complete bottom cloud outline, with a little transparent margin on all sides in a wide landscape composition. Outside the combined figure-and-cloud silhouette use actual alpha transparency. The cloud, face and dress interiors should be opaque white. No sky, scenery, paper rectangle, cast shadow, glow, text, border or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent PNG black-and-white line-art web illustration.
Make ONE framing adjustment to the attached black-and-white drawing of the woman seated on a cloud: extend the transparent canvas margin around the complete illustration.
Keep the exact same black ink line drawing, face, hairstyle, expression, seated posture, hands, clothing folds, embroidery, shoes and cloud design unchanged. Keep the white interior fills and sparse black hatching. Preserve the horizontal landscape composition.
Place the existing combined woman-and-cloud silhouette slightly smaller in the center of the canvas, occupying at most 85% of canvas height, leaving at least 7% completely empty transparent space above the top hair ornament and below the LOWEST cloud curve, and clear transparent margins to the left and right. Carefully complete any tiny cut-off bottom cloud contour so the full cloud is enclosed and no line touches the image boundary.
Every pixel outside the combined silhouette must be transparent, especially all four canvas edges. No new objects, text, color, gray fills, paper texture, glow, shadow, background or border. Change only the outer framing and the tiny boundary completion needed for the full cloud outline.

validation: 已查看最终生成图；核验透明通道、四边无不透明像素、保存副本与生成源 SHA-256 一致。未执行页面集成测试。
